publisher: National Museum of the Philippines, Architectural Arts and Built Heritage
articleTitle: The Patrocinio de Maria Church in Boljoon, Cebu

facts.front: East-facing pediment, horizontal mouldings and pilaster divisions. Round-arched central entrance and a trefoil upper shrine niche. The triangular apex bears an Augustinian emblem.
facts.wallConstruction: Coral masonry, heavy side buttresses and carved trim.
facts.attachedConvent: Two storeys immediately south of the church. Retains clay roof tiles.
facts.belfry: An eighteenth-century watchtower on the north side of the front was repurposed as the belfry.
